title: Introduction Notes: Khalsa Authority and Kapoor Singh

blocks.text: This front-matter note preserves quoted evidence about Khalsa authority and recognition rather than a direct page of narrative. Its first quotation describes a power that had devastated Delhi and names Nadir or Ahmad Shah as enemies, but says the Khalsa forced Ahmad Shah’s side to flee.

The second quotation turns to Kapoor Singh. It shows him humbly serving the Singhs, then records an Akal command received by the Panth to honor him with a robe of honor because his service had reached the proper station.

The final citation from Episode 90 describes arranging five camps or standards and bringing Nishan flags from Sri Akal Bunga, so the page reads as a citation cluster about Khalsa authority and recognition.
